description: This file defines the 'Waiter' class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which manages polling AWS resources until they reach a desired state using promises and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: Waiter
classes.description: A class that manages polling AWS resources until a specified condition is met, using promises for asynchronous handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Waiter with client, name, arguments, and configuration, validating required options.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the waiter condition is met or rejects on failure.

methods.name: getArgsForAttempt
methods.description: Prepares the arguments for each polling attempt, including delay handling.

methods.name: determineState
methods.description: Determines the current state ('success', 'failed', 'retry') based on the result of polling.

methods.name: matchesPath
methods.description: Checks if the result matches a specific path and expected value.

methods.name: matchesPathAll
methods.description: Checks if all values in a path match the expected value.

methods.name: matchesPathAny
methods.description: Checks if any value in a path matches the expected value.

methods.name: matchesStatus
methods.description: Checks if the response status code matches the expected status.

methods.name: matchesError
methods.description: Checks if the result is an error matching expected error conditions.
